title: NODE 000 — The Willow in the Yard

features.name: an ice cream container tied to the willow
features.desc-on-touch: An empty ice cream container with the hardware seated inside it, tied to the trunk. The first proper module. It has one job and one file.

features.name: the kitchen window
features.desc-on-touch: Two people lean against the sink with dessert bowls, looking into the yard. The clock on the wall sends its sync pulse. And then it begins to sing.

features.name: a bell miner, MIDI
features.desc-on-touch: An electric piano tuned to a high octave, staccato tapped. Bellbirds are gully birds. Is a wrong-sounding bellbird still a bellbird. The question did not need an answer.

features.name: the kitchen clock's sync pulse
features.desc-on-touch: A basic protocol: the clock says now, and the module starts its bellbird rendition. Everything after this is elaboration.

inscription: and then it began to sing

file.name: BellMiner_Year3000.mid
file.note: Extracted from a university student's simulation of Newcastle a thousand years on. Triggered by a kitchen clock.

exits.label: the fence at the back of the yard
exits.to: NEW: the neighbour's yard, where the kitchen clock's sync pulse can still be heard through the palings
